biotools.summary: INTOB is a software resource developed by the UFZ for the collection and management of toxicological data, adhering to FAIR principles. It standardizes the collection of metadata and phenotypic observations, particularly for zebrafish embryo toxicity tests, to improve data comparability and facilitate data-driven analyses.
